summary: Phase-32 items-normalization bug-fix verification — ALL GREEN (6/6 passed in 8.94s). Confirmed the AttributeError 500 on POST /api/orders/pending/{id}/ship is fully resolved. All 5 input shapes for overrides.items behave correctly: (1) LIST ['Shirt','Cap'] → items=['Shirt','Cap'], item_description='Shirt, Cap'; (2) STRING 'Shirt, Cap' (legacy) → same result; (3) empty list [] → items=[], item_description=''; (4) None → items=[] (defensive else-branch); (5) ['  ','Cap',''] → items=['Cap'] (whitespace+empties stripped). Regression test #6 (no overrides at all) still uses pending row's stored items correctly. The fix at routers/shipments_write.py:755-783 (isinstance check) plus the derived item_description at line 820 (", ".join(items_list)) both verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/shipments_write.py:761-777 — isinstance ladder is clean (list→strip+drop empties, str→split+strip, else→[]). Defensive fallback prevents future crashes from any unexpected shape (dict, int, etc.).

routers/shipments_write.py:820 — item_description = ', '.join(items_list) cleanly derives the legacy flat-string field from the normalised list, keeping both shapes in sync for WhatsApp templates and CSV exports.

Minor: the `_get('items', '')` default is an empty string while items_raw could legitimately be None when the override explicitly sets items=None. The else-branch on line 776 handles this correctly today but a future refactor that drops the else would re-introduce the crash for None. Add an inline comment or unit test in the module to guard.
seed_data_creation: 6 fresh pending orders created via /api/smart-paste under user2 tenant, prefixed TEST_P32_ITM_ for cleanup identification. Each promoted to a shipment to exercise the items-normalization branches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The items-normalization fix on routers/shipments_write.py is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_phase32_items_normalization.py — 6 tests covering list/string/empty/None/whitespace + a no-override regression. rca_of_issue: Root cause: routers/shipments_write.py previously called `items_str.split(',')` unconditionally on whatever shape arrived in overrides['items']. The Phase-32 frontend form changed from a single comma-separated text input to a multi-row array, so the field is now a real Python list when it comes through JSON. The list has no .split() method → AttributeError → 500. Fix applied by main agent (verified): isinstance(items_raw, list) branch normalises directly; isinstance(items_raw, str) preserves legacy split; else→[] as defensive fallback for None/dict/int/etc. Then item_description is rebuilt from items_list via ', '.join() so both legacy-string and new-list consumers see consistent values. All 5 input shapes from the bug report + 1 regression case confirmed passing.
